idea: A little paper postman loses his last letter to a gust of wind, chases it down the street, and it drops into the mailbox on its own
leave: Some things find their way even when you drop them
subject: the red letter

device.what: the letter is the only red thing in a grey paper street
device.why: the eye follows the letter the whole way, from his hand to the slot

change.to: the postman has walked in with the red letter in his hand

change.from: the letter sits in his hand
change.to: the wind has carried it high over his head
he has run down the street under it, close to the mailbox

change.from: the letter drops into the slot
change.to: he waves at the mailbox and the words 寄到了 have appeared
